++++++++android.widget.TextView interesting name='Figurative Map of the successive losses in men of the French Army in the Russian campaign 1812-1813. Drawn by Mr. Minard, Inspector General of Bridges and Roads in retirement. Paris, 20 November 1869.'
++++++++android.widget.TextView interesting name='The numbers of men present are represented by the widths of the colored zones in a rate of one millimeter for ten thousand men; these are also written beside the zones. Red designates men moving into Russia, black those on retreat.'
++++++++android.widget.TextView interesting name='The information used for drawing the map were taken from the works of Messrs. Thiers, de S%C3%A9gur, de Fezensac, de Chambray and the unpublished diary of Jacob, pharmacist of the Army since 28 October.'
